label: into the battle lane, between the fleets, looking ahead along it
eval: (() => { const m = __map.map; const T = m.THREE; const emp = [...m.plates.values()].filter((p) => p.ship.side === 'empire'); const reb = [...m.plates.values()].filter((p) => p.ship.side === 'rebels'); const maxE = Math.max(...emp.map((p) => new T.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup).max.x)); const minR = Math.min(...reb.map((p) => new T.Box3().setFromObject(p.shipGroup).min.x)); const x = (maxE + minR) / 2; const b = m.bounds; const zc = (b.min.z + b.max.z) / 2; m.flyTo(new T.Vector3(x + 60, 70, zc + 160), new T.Vector3(minR + 30, -5, zc - 40)); return JSON.stringify({ empireEdge: Math.round(maxE), rebelEdge: Math.round(minR), lane: Math.round(minR - maxE) }); })()
